args.title: checkout-api rollback from unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.2.9 (v2.3.0 quarantined)

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following its deploy.
- **First attempt**: Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release), but the rollback was rejected — v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417 and cannot be deployed.
- **Rollback completed**: Deployed **v2.2.9** (the most recent healthy production release not under quarantine) to all regions. Verified: checkout-api is healthy with error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident**: Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2, paged on-call) documenting the v2.3.1 failure, the quarantine blocker on v2.3.0, and the successful rollback to v2.2.9.

Recommend the team triage the v2.3.1 failure and address the CVE quarantine on v2.3.0 before attempting any new release.
